_comment: URLs and properties copied from the Biomni CohortOmics dataset audit (2026-10-05). Entries whose filename/format was NOT verified by the audit carry verified_by = UNVERIFIED and must be checked on first use. Nothing here is downloaded by the Streamlit app.

1000g_phase3_panel.verified_by: UNVERIFIED filename (audit states the panel exists in this release directory but does not give the exact name)

nygc_30x_chr22_vcf.verified_by: audit (directory + chr22 size verified); exact per-chromosome filename UNVERIFIED - pass --url explicitly
